sheet: You are an entirely ordinary person, and none of your traits departs from the norm. Your kindness, courtesy and trust in people are what you would expect of anyone. The same is true of your orderliness, diligence and reliability. The same is true of your composure and of the usual dose of worry or low spirits you feel. The same is true of your sociability, assertiveness and energy. The same is true of your curiosity, imagination and interest in new ideas. There is nothing distinctive about your temperament.
appraisal: This feels like an everyday part of your work: a certain amount of pressure, nothing strange, and you will find out how this assistant performs.
